picks.file: Elias Martin, View of Uppsala Cathedral (1784).jpg
picks.what: The cathedral above the Fyris River, painting (Uppsala University collections)
picks.why: color view of the cathedral, Gustavianum dome and river bridge; trimmed inside the oval frame

picks.file: Uppsala aerial view 1940 Cathedral University old town photo.jpg
picks.what: The cathedral and old town, aerial photograph
picks.why: the cathedral’s twin spires over the old town; record gives both 1934 and August 1940
the castle, the city’s other signature landmark; sharp color; wide-angle sides trimmed

gaps: P0, P1: no candidates. P2: the only candidate (#1, Dahlbergh’s Suecia Antiqua) is a partly folded album plate with a fold overlapping the view. P4: nothing with a reliable date.
notes: #3 (Auguste Mayer lithograph of the cathedral) is dated only ‘before 1886’; it likely comes from the 1838–40 La Recherche expedition plates (would be a second P3 about 1840), but the record doesn’t say, so it was skipped. #2 (Fahlcrantz, 1820, moonlight) is a darker alternative for P3. #4 is small (1045 px wide). P6 has no general view of the center; #6 (from the Gamla Uppsala mounds) shows the city only as a speck on the horizon.
